title: In-silico identification and validation of Silibinin as a dual inhibitor for ENO1 and GLUT4 to curtail EMT signaling and TNBC progression.
authors: Venkatesh, Dheepika; Sarkar, Shilpi; Kandasamy, Thirukumaran; Ghosh, Siddhartha Sankar
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和MD模拟鉴定Silibinin对ENO1和GLUT4的双重抑制，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法部分可借鉴。
abstract: The aberrant metabolic reprogramming endows TNBC cells with sufficient ATP and lactate required for survival and metastasis. Hence, the intervention of the metabolic network represents a promising avenue to alleviate the Warburg effect in TNBC cells to impair their invasive and metastatic potential. Multitudinous in-silico analysis identified Enolase1 (ENO1) and the surface transporter protein, GLUT4 to be the potential targets for the abrogation of the metabolic network. The expression profiles of ENO1 and GLUT4 genes showed anomalous expression in various cancers, including breast cancer. Subsequently, the functional and physiological interactions of the target proteins were analyzed from the protein-protein interaction network. The pathway enrichment analysis identified the prime cancer signaling pathways in which these proteins are involved. Further, docking results bestowed Silibinin as the concurrent inhibitor of ENO1 and GLUT4. Moreover, the stable interaction of Silibinin with both proteins deciphered the binding free energies values of -48.86 and -104.31 KJ/mol from MMPBSA analysis and MD simulation, respectively. Furthermore, the cell viability, ROS assay, and live-dead imaging underscored the pronounced cytotoxicity of Silibinin, illuminating its capacity to incur apoptosis within TNBC cells. Additionally, glycolysis assay and gene expression analysis demonstrated the silibinin-mediated inhibition of the glycolysis pathway. Eventually, a lipidomic reprogramming towards fatty acid metabolism was established from the elevated lipid droplet accumulation, exogenous fatty acid uptake and de-novo lipogenesis. Nevertheless, repression of EMT and Wnt pathway progression by Silibinin was perceived from the gene expression studies. Overall, the current study highlights the tweaking of intricate signaling crosstalk between glycolysis and the Wnt pathway in TNBC cells through inhibiting ENO1 and GLUT4.
abstract_zh: 异常的代谢重编程赋予TNBC细胞生存和转移所需的充足ATP和乳酸。因此，干预代谢网络是缓解TNBC细胞中Warburg效应、削弱其侵袭和转移潜力的一个有前景的途径。多项计算机模拟分析确定烯醇化酶1（ENO1）和表面转运蛋白GLUT4为破坏代谢网络的潜在靶点。ENO1和GLUT4基因的表达谱在包括乳腺癌在内的多种癌症中显示出异常表达。随后，通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析了靶蛋白的功能和生理相互作用。通路富集分析确定了这些蛋白参与的主要癌症信号通路。此外，对接结果赋予水飞蓟宾（Silibinin）作为ENO1和GLUT4的同时抑制剂。而且，水飞蓟宾与两种蛋白的稳定相互作用通过MMPBSA分析和分子动力学（MD）模拟分别解析出-48.86和-104.31 kJ/mol的结合自由能值。进一步地，细胞活力、ROS检测和活死成像强调了水飞蓟宾的显著细胞毒性，阐明了其在TNBC细胞中诱导凋亡的能力。此外，糖酵解测定和基因表达分析证明了水飞蓟宾介导的糖酵解通路抑制。最终，通过升高的脂滴积累、外源性脂肪酸摄取和从头脂肪生成，确立了向脂肪酸代谢的脂质组学重编程。然而，基因表达研究观察到水飞蓟宾对上皮-间质转化（EMT）和Wnt通路进展的抑制。总体而言，当前研究强调了通过抑制ENO1和GLUT4来调控TNBC细胞中糖酵解与Wnt通路之间复杂信号串扰的作用。
